# Capacity plan (generated by tuning/capacity.py)

Data as of 2026-09-30. Measured on-disk cost: **510 B per transaction** (data + 9 indexes) and **148 B per ledger line**; 2.28 ledger lines per transaction, so each transaction costs **849 B** in total.

| Month | Transactions |
|---|---|
| 2025-09 | 375,718 |
| 2025-10 | 408,028 |
| 2025-11 | 408,354 |
| 2025-12 | 439,463 |
| 2026-01 | 459,737 |

| 2026-03 | 601,253 |
| 2026-04 | 489,448 |
| 2026-05 | 657,686 |
| 2026-06 | 524,210 |
| 2026-07 | 565,211 |
| 2026-08 | 583,830 |

Trend: **+20,547 transactions/month each month** (~4.2% of the average month).

| Horizon | Transactions/month | Total transactions | Database size | Hot 90-day working set |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| now | 583,830 | 10,280,371 | 8.4 GB | 1.3 GB |
| +12 months | 853,980 | 19,172,052 | 15.4 GB | 2.0 GB |
| +24 months | 1,100,540 | 31,022,456 | 24.8 GB | 2.6 GB |

Binary logs (7 days kept), backups (2 full + 3 logical) and the binlog archive come on top: budget roughly 3x the database size for the volume holding data and backups.
